summary: Saratoga Investment Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that on October 8, 2026, it and its wholly owned financing subsidiary, Saratoga Investment Funding II LLC (SIF II), entered into a First Amendment to the Credit and Security Agreement with Valley National Bank as administrative agent and U.S. Bank Trust as collateral agent/administrator. The amendment raises commitments from $85.0 million to $110.0 million, lifts the accordion from $100.0 million to $135.0 million, caps unitranche advance rates at 70%, expands healthcare and top-three-obligor concentration limits, and replaces a key person. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
